existing.funding_period: one-year tenure, paid as a single tuition fee credit
existing.description: The University of Otago Global Scholarships provide NZD $15,000 towards tuition fees to new international Bachelor degree students who hold a passport from one of twelve nominated countries — Bangladesh, China, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Macau, Malaysia, Singapore, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Thailand or Vietnam. There is no separate scholarship application: candidates are automatically assessed during the admission process and must tick the agreement to be considered for international scholarships in their eVision application for study. The scholarship is paid only as a credit towards tuition fees with a one-year tenure, is not deferrable, and becomes invalid if study does not commence by the enrolment date in the Offer of Place. Applicants must study on campus, and students sponsored by their home government or the New Zealand government are not eligible.
eligibility: Have completed secondary (high) school, or studied at another approved institution that grants University Entrance either overseas or within New Zealand

Intend to enrol or have enrolled in full-time undergraduate degree-level study, or in an approved foundation diploma programme, with the objective of progressing into an undergraduate degree at the University of Otago
Intend to study at the University of Otago from 100-level (first year) through to degree attainment

Be applying to study at the University of Otago from a nominated country (Bangladesh, China, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Macau, Malaysia, Singapore, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam) and/or be undertaking a specified programme of study at Otago
Study on campus throughout the duration of their studies
Not be sponsored by their home government or the New Zealand government
existing.eligibility_summary: New international students from nominated countries who hold a passport from Bangladesh, China, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Macau, Malaysia, Singapore, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Thailand or Vietnam and are commencing full-time undergraduate degree-level study at the University of Otago from 100 level through to degree. Applicants must be studying on campus throughout their studies and cannot be sponsored by their home government or the New Zealand government.

existing.selection_notes: Selection of recipients is based on academic potential as demonstrated by programme admission, together with holding a passport from one of the nominated countries. existing.application_period: Applications open 1 May in the year prior to study for offshore students (1 July for onshore students) and close 10 December for a Semester 1 (February) start, or 30 April for a Semester 2 (July) start for offshore students.
existing.deadline_display: Opening date 1 May in year prior to study for offshore students, 1 July for onshore students. Closing dates 10 December for semester 1 (February) start, 30 April for semester 2 (July) start for offshore students, 15 August for onshore students.
